define: Tax paid to the IRS during the year, in four parts, on income that has no tax taken out, such as money from working for yourself. It covers income tax and self-employment tax together. The IRS generally expects it from people who will owe $1,000 or more when they file.
example: A student who expects to owe $1,200 when she files pays part of it by each of the four due dates, not all of it in April.
